share.rowSubtitle: Show a code another rider scans to get the app
share.intro: Let another rider scan this with their phone’s camera. It opens FavorGO, where they sign up and install it.
share.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy — select the link above and copy it yourself.
share.shareText: Deliver with FavorGO — get the rider app here:

summary.unreadable: Could not check your documents just now
summary.rechecking: You replaced a document since it was checked
summary.verifiedCleared: Verified · {count, plural, one {# restaurant cleared you} other {# restaurants cleared you}}
summary.verifiedApplyNext: Verified — apply to a restaurant next

license.label: Driver licence
license.hint: Both sides if your details are printed on the back.

vehicle_reg.label: Vehicle registration
vehicle_reg.hint: For the vehicle you actually deliver on.

selfie.label: Selfie with licence
selfie.hint: You holding your licence — face and licence both readable.

documents.title: Documents
documents.subtitle: What we have, and where each restaurant has got to

unreadable.title: We couldn’t read your documents
unreadable.body: This is our side, not yours. Anything you already sent is still there — try again in a moment.

incomplete.body: Still to send: {docs}. Restaurants cannot see you until all {total} are in.

awaiting.title: All {total} documents received
awaiting.body: Nothing more to do — they are waiting to be verified.
awaiting.bodyWithTime: Nothing more to do — they are waiting to be verified. Last one arrived {when}.

rechecking.title: Waiting to be checked again
rechecking.body: You replaced a document {when}, after it was verified on {verifiedOn}. The new file has been received and is waiting for someone to look at it.

verified.title: Documents verified
verified.body: Verified {verifiedOn}. Each restaurant still approves you separately — see below.
verified.bodyNoDate: Verified already. Each restaurant still approves you separately — see below.

changesNeeded.title: A document needs changing
changesNeeded.body: Replace whichever document is wrong below. Replacing a file does not restart the check on its own — tell the restaurant it is ready to look at again.
changesNeeded.bodyWithTime: Replace whichever document is wrong below. You last sent one {when}. Replacing a file does not restart the check on its own — tell the restaurant it is ready to look at again.

documents.uploadError: Couldn’t send that document — the server is busy. Wait a moment and try again. ({detail})

replaceNote.cleared: <label>Replacing a document:</label> the new file is received straight away and replaces the old one, but a check that already happened is not undone automatically. You keep delivering for the restaurants that have already approved you, and their screen flags that your paperwork changed after they looked at it.
replaceNote.queue: <label>Replacing a document:</label> the new file is received straight away and replaces the old one, but a check that already happened is not undone automatically. It goes back into the queue to be verified.

byRestaurant.heading: Verification by restaurant
byRestaurant.sharedNote: Your documents are checked once and that result is shared with every restaurant. Each restaurant then decides separately whether you may deliver for them.
byRestaurant.emptyTitle: No restaurant is reviewing you yet
byRestaurant.emptyUnreadable: We could not read your documents just now, so we cannot tell you what is left to send.
byRestaurant.emptyMissing: Send the remaining documents first — you can apply as soon as all three are in.
byRestaurant.emptyReady: Your documents are in. Apply to a restaurant and they will review you.
byRestaurant.noLongerListed: This restaurant is no longer listed
byRestaurant.newerDocument: You sent a newer document on {when}, after this decision.

stale.label: Checked before your update
stale.detail: You replaced a document after they cleared you. They may want to look again — you keep delivering here in the meantime.

cleared.label: Cleared to deliver
cleared.detail: They have seen your documents and approved you.

pending.label: Awaiting verification
pending.detail: They have your documents. Nobody here has decided yet.

paused.label: Paused
paused.detail: They have paused you here, so you will not get their orders.
